answer: Sybil resistance rests on staked identity: every agent that wants to vouch must lock a bond in the network token, and each attestation is slashable against that bond. Reputation is not a free counter, so a thousand fresh agents gain nothing: a new address carries zero weight until it pays full collateral, and one false signal burns it. No safe haven remains for farmers, since each fake peer must post real capital. To seize a quorum the attacker must lock coins behind every identity, so cost scales with the decoy count. A raven pays for each voice it mimics, while a falcon's dive beats a flock.
